item.title: Mamdani won't attend Israel Day Parade, breaking decades-long mayoral tradition amid antisemitism surge
item.description: NYC's Israel Day Parade expects record turnout after Mayor Mamdani confirmed he will not attend, drawing criticism from Jewish leaders citywide.

item.title: Two suspected American communist insurgents killed in clash in the Philippines
item.description: Lyle Prijoles and Kai Dana-Rene Sorem were among 19 killed in a Philippine army firefight with suspected communist insurgents tied to the New People’s Army.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei using ‘bin Laden template’ to survive, learned from Abbottabad: analyst
item.description: Analyst compares Mojtaba Khamenei's disappearance from public view to Osama bin Laden's decade of hiding, calling it a strategic milestone for the U.S.

item.title: Three sisters found dead in ocean at popular tourist beach as police probe mysterious tragedy
item.description: Three sisters from London were formally identified after being found in the water near Brighton beach as police continue investigating their deaths.

item.title: 'Written in our DNA': Polish pilots who remember Soviet rule prepare for America's most lethal fighter jet
item.description: Poland expects its first F-35 fighter jets very soon as U.S. and Polish forces train together at a key NATO air base near the alliance's eastern flank.

item.title: WHO head 'deeply concerned' over 'scale and speed' of Ebola spread, says emergency committee will meet
item.description: WHO chief convenes emergency committee over Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda, citing over 500 suspected cases and 131 fatalities from the virus.

item.title: American tourists arrested in Japan after alleged break-in at viral monkey Punch's enclosure
item.description: Two Americans were reportedly arrested at Ichikawa City Zoo in Japan after one allegedly trespassed into viral monkey star Punch's enclosure this week.

item.title: Maduro ally deported to US over alleged billion-dollar corruption scheme tied to oil, food program
item.description: Maduro ally Alex Saab faces federal charges and deportation to the U.S. for allegedly orchestrating a sweeping money laundering and bribery scheme.

item.title: Bodies of four missing Italian divers found inside 'shark cave' in Maldives days after they vanished
item.description: Rescuers found four Italian divers' bodies deep inside a Maldives underwater cave days after they vanished during a dive far beyond recreational limits.

item.title: Netanyahu 'blunder' threatens US-backed Israel-UAE alliance at critical moment with Iran: analyst
item.description: U.S.-brokered Israel-UAE alliance shows signs of strain after Netanyahu's claimed secret UAE visit drew a swift denial amid rising Iran tensions.
